data.turoyo: W čik šəkwak b lebux w mətǧabrət qm u=alohayḏux.
data.translation: Und es sind Zweifel in dein Herz gekommen, und du bist hoffärtig geworden vor deinem Gott

rationale: Thin Infectum cell; second-person form complements the existing third-person example.

summary: Both occurrences support the inherited hoffärtig werden sense and qm setting before God; no difference in lexical meaning or argument construction warrants a new sense.
Retain glossary stem I for the lexical Arabic-derived tǧbr form. Initial mət- is not sufficient to reassign it to a Detransitive of another Turoyo root.
The second-person -ət form is Infectum in the supplied mətǧaballe/mətǧabər paradigm; the edition completed-becoming translation does not establish a different form box.

Does tǧbr specifically express becoming arrogant, acting arrogantly, or both? The two narrative German translations support the inherited gloss, but the Turoyo event-versus-state distinction needs speaker evidence.
